Empowerments.brief_instruction: Analyze my request above and brief me before carrying out the task. In a single message, ask all necessary and useful clarifying questions to make the request actionable. Identify missing details about the goal, context, audience, expected result, constraints, priorities and success criteria, but only where relevant to this task. Do not ask about information I have already provided or invent facts. Group and number the questions, putting essential questions first and marking optional questions. Wait for my answers before proposing the final solution or carrying out the task. Respond in the language of my request.
